title: Oceania Cruises® Unveils Black Friday Savings of Up To 50% Across All 2027 Voyages
body_markdown:
Over 200 2027 Sailings Join the Black Friday Offer, Featuring Worldwide Journeys Aboard Oceania Cruises' Luxury Ships


*Oceania Allura™* in Split, Croatia. Download high-resolution images[here.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=3431428221&u=https%3A%2F%2Fncl.box.com%2Fs%2Fhja7kwnpqypeuwed8zr2zc9w1khbph47&a=here.) (Credit: Oceania Cruises and David Rossow.)


MIAMI


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- A whole year of exploring is on the horizon with[Oceania Cruises®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=989714173&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2F&a=Oceania+Cruises%C2%AE) , as the world's leading destination- and culinary-focused luxury cruise line reveals up to 50% savings across all 2027 voyages as part of its Black Friday offer.


Available to book from November 18 through to December 1, 2026, the offer encompasses over 200 voyages, giving travelers an opportunity to plan a year of worldwide discovery.


The collection spans across the entire fleet to sought-after destinations and lesser-explored gems, with highlight sailings to the Eastern Mediterranean. Guests can uncover storied cities, like Dubrovnik, Athens, and Venice as well as idyllic islands and coastlines including Kusadasi, Santorini and Kotor.


Oceania Cruises' itineraries venture to 600 ports worldwide, meaning 2027 sailings also offer sojourns through the rugged wilderness of Alaska, crystal waters of the Caribbean, the far reaches of Asia and beyond.


**Highlight itineraries include:**


- [10 days aboard Oceania Marina™ , from Istanbul to Trieste.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=274990939&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FMNA271028%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-10%2526ship%253DMNA%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=10+days+aboard+Oceania+Marina%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Istanbul+to+Trieste.) 28 October to 7 November 2027, with 50% off. Explore the Eastern Mediterranean, with visits to ancient Olympia, Montenegro's Kotor and Croatia's stunning Dalmatian Coast.
- [7 days aboard Oceania Allura™ , from Athens to Rome.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=3830300851&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FALU271015%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-10%2526ship%253DALU%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=7+days+aboard+Oceania+Allura%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Athens+to+Rome.) 15 October to 22 October 2027, with 45% off. Journey through the Aegean and Italy, calling at Ephesus, Crete, Olympia and the shores of Sicily.
- [9 days aboard Oceania Allura , from Barcelona to Rome.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=3434930127&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FALU271117%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-11%2526ship%253DALU%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=9+days+aboard+Oceania+Allura%2C+from+Barcelona+to+Rome.) 17 November to 26 November 2027, with 45% off. Discover Mediterranean Island treasures, from Barcelona to Rome, with visits to Menorca, Sardinia, Sicily and Italy's historic coastline.
- [12 days aboard Oceania Aurelia™ , from Trieste to Athens](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=2126772955&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FARL271206%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-12%2526ship%253DARL%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=12+days+aboard+Oceania+Aurelia%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Trieste+to+Athens) . 6 December to 18 December 2027, with 35% off. Follow historic Adriatic and Aegean routes, visiting Kotor, Crete, Rhodes, Ephesus and Istanbul.
- [7 days aboard Oceania Marina , from Miami to Miami.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=599180540&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FMNA271220%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-12%2526ship%253DMNA%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=7+days+aboard+Oceania+Marina%2C+from+Miami+to+Miami.) 20 December to 27 December 2027, with 35% off. Escape to the Western Caribbean, with calls in Costa Maya, Belize City, Roatán and Cozumel.
- [10 days aboard Oceania Riviera™ , from Seattle to Seattle.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=984089884&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FRVA270524%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-5%2526ship%253DRVA%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=10+days+aboard+Oceania+Riviera%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Seattle+to+Seattle.) 24 May to 3 June 2027, with 30% off. Venture through Alaska's wild frontier, exploring Ketchikan, Juneau, glacier fjords and charming Victoria.
- [9 days aboard Oceania Sonata™ , from Trieste to Barcelona](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=3330313564&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FSON270821%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-8%2526ship%253DSON%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=9+days+aboard+Oceania+Sonata%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Trieste+to+Barcelona) . 21 August to 30 August 2027, with 30% off. Discover Mediterranean icons, from Dubrovnik and Sorrento to Rome, Tuscany and Provence aboard the lines' newest ship.
- [12 days aboard Oceania Sirena™ , from Miami to Miami.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=1122320109&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FSIR271128%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-11%2526ship%253DSIR%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=12+days+aboard+Oceania+Sirena%E2%84%A2%2C+from+Miami+to+Miami.) 28 November to 10 December 2027, with 25% off. Delve into the southern Caribbean, visiting Aruba, Curaçao, Bonaire, Grenada and St. Lucia.
- [11 days aboard Oceania Riviera , from Hong Kong to Tokyo.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=38274460&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FRVA270416%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-4%2526ship%253DRVA%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=11+days+aboard+Oceania+Riviera%2C+from+Hong+Kong+to+Tokyo.) 16 April to 27 April 2027, with 10% off. Experience Asia's cultural crossroads, with stops in Taipei, Busan, Nagasaki, Kyoto and Tokyo.
- [14 days aboard Oceania Sonata , from Rome to Trieste.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=2123776990&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2Fcruises%2FSON270807%2F%3Fsr%3D%252Fcruise-finder%2523time_frame%253D2027-8%2526ship%253DSON%2526sort%253Dfeatured%253Adesc%2526page%253D1%2526pageSize%253D10&a=14+days+aboard+Oceania+Sonata%2C+from+Rome+to+Trieste.) 7 August to 21 August 2027, with 10% off. Trace the Mediterranean's legendary shores, from Malta and Mykonos to Corfu, Montenegro and Croatia.


With incredible value of up to 50% across all 2027 voyages, the Black Friday offer is available to book through to December 1, 2026, opening even more opportunities to experience the Joy of Traveling Well in 2027.


*Discounts are subject to change and applicable for specific stateroom categories. For further information please visit*[OceaniaCruises.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=4292865234&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2F&a=OceaniaCruises.com) *or contact your travel advisor.*


For more information on Oceania Cruises intimate, luxurious ships and Black Friday savings, visit[OceaniaCruises.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823960-1&h=4292865234&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oceaniacruises.com%2F&a=OceaniaCruises.com) or call 866-985-1318.


**About Oceania Cruises®**


Oceania Cruises® is the world's leading destination- and culinary-focused luxury cruise line, celebrated for its port-rich voyages and authentic cultural and culinary experiences. The line's intimate, luxurious ships feature an adults-only environment, with a high proportion of spacious rooms and suites, calling on more than 600 marquee and boutique ports in more than 100 countries across seven continents, with destination-intensive itineraries ranging from seven to 180 days. Aboard the designer-inspired ships, guests enjoy personalized service supported by a strong crew-to-guest ratio, alongside The Finest Cuisine at Sea®, prepared by one of the highest chef-to-guest ratios at sea. Oceania Cruises® is also recognized as one of the world's most awarded cruise lines, with accolades spanning luxury, dining, service and destination experiences. Oceania Cruises® has five Sonata Class ships on order scheduled for delivery in 2027, 2029, 2032, 2035 and 2037. Oceania Cruises® is a wholly owned subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH).
